PART I. GENERAL PROVISIONS

In this article, "savings bank" means a corporation which has the authority to operate as a savings bank under this chapter.
bodyHtml:
ARTICLE 6.  SAVINGS BANKS

 

PART I.  GENERAL PROVISIONS

 

     §412:6-100  Definition.  In this article, "savings bank" means a corporation which has the authority to operate as a savings bank under this chapter. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
